plant_banboo.usage: Plant the Bamboo's seed in the Garden and water it daily. After 3 days, it will be ready, giving a Bamboo upon harvesting. The player can water the plant daily to keep harvesting it once per day. However, if the player doesn't harvest it and let the plant grow one more time by watering it again, the next day it'll become a Millennia Bamboo.

plant_binary_tree.usage: Plant the {{PAGENAME}}'s seed in the Garden and water it once. After 1 day, it will be ready, giving the Shotgun Buff upon harvesting. After being harvested, the plant will disappear.

plant_carrot.usage: Plant the Carrot's seed in the Garden and water it. Next time the player enters the game, it will grow once, at this state, the player can harvest carrot. Letting the plant grow one more time by watering it again, the next visit it'll become a Centennial Carrot.

plant_datura.usage: Plant the Devil's Snare's seed in the Garden and water it daily. After 7 days, it will be ready, giving a Pet upon harvesting. The player can keep watering the plant daily to harvest it once per day. *The pet 40px has 10 base health. The health bar is not visible. **Its health cannot get lower than 1. If its HP is reduced to 1, it will stop fighting and stay close to the player. **It takes 14~16 seconds for it to be fully healed. It can also regenerate health during battle at an unknown rate. *The pet shoots 3 bullets in a cone pattern. Each bullet deals 3 damage and inflicts Poison debuff on critical hits. **Shotgun adds 2 more bullets (for a total of 5). **Poison increases Poison debuff damage. **Accuracy reduces bullet spread angle. **Elemental Staff allows it to deal double damage on critical hits. *The pet can move over blocks and crates. While the pet can stack with other pets, the player can have only one Devil Snare pet each run. If the player attempt to harvest more Devil Snares when they already have one, the plants will do nothing.

plant_eator.usage: Plant the {{PAGENAME}}'s seed in the Garden and water it once. After 1 day, it will be ready, giving this Pet for the current run only. After being harvested, the plant will disappear. *The pet 35px has 15 base health. The health bar is visible. **Its health cannot get lower than 1. If its HP is reduced to 1, it will stop fighting and stay close to the player, the health bar will also turn red. **It takes 14~16 seconds for it to be fully healed. It can also regenerate health during battle at an unknown rate. *The pet bites enemies, deals 5 damage (8 damage on critical hits) each attack. **Pet increases its health by 10 and damage by 3. **The pet is affected by Statue of the Berserker resulting in big munches. While the pet can stack with other pets, the player can have only one Titan Arum pet from garden each run. If the player attempts to harvest more than one {{PAGENAME}}, the plant will do nothing. Other than that, using Cannibal Plant can also summon the same pets. Pets summoned by the weapon don't have number limit, but will disappear soon.

plant_rosemary.product: Icicle Spike or Ice Sculpture or Frost Nova
plant_rosemary.usage: Plant {{PAGENAME}}'s seed in the Garden and water it once. After 1 day, it will be ready, giving one of the following buffs upon harvesting. After being harvested, the plant will disappear: * Icicle Spike - Ice-based critical attacks launch 3 ice spikes at all directions. * Ice Sculpture - Enemies killed by ice damage have a 50% chance of turning into ice sculptures, which automatically pursue other enemies and explode, dealing 12 ice damage to enemies within a radius of 2. * Frost Nova - Enemies killed by ice damage have a 40% chance to trigger a frost nova upon death.

After being harvested, the plant will disappear. *The pet 35px has 10 base health. The health bar is not visible. **Its health cannot get lower than 1. If its HP is reduced to 1, it will stop fighting and stay close to the player. **It takes 14~16 seconds for it to be fully healed. It can also regenerate health during battle at an unknown rate. **Being a Garden Pet, it isn't affected by buffs provided by Pet Food upgrades. *The pet uses a 48x32px Zongzi Gun as a weapon.
